desc: (116 mins) Throughout the history of hacker culture, elevators have played a key role. From the mystique of students at MIT taking late-night rides upon car tops (don't do that, please!) to the work of modern pen testers who use elevators to bypass building security systems (it's easier than you think!), these devices are often misunderstood and their full range of features and abilities go unexpl
